messages.author: f46993b38e0d7272
messages.subject: Reading in methylBaseDB/methylDiffDB flat files
parts:
Hi,

Is there a function that can read in methylBaseDB/methylDiffDB flat file databases, similar to how methRead can work on methylRaw(List)DB files? I'd like to source my code into a clean environment on each RStudio startup, but I don't want to have to run calculateDiffMeth every time.

Thanks!
Nia

messages.author: a413e6cf6c4ea2cc
messages.subject: Re: Reading in methylBaseDB/methylDiffDB flat files
parts:
Am Samstag, 26. Oktober 2019 03:32:47 UTC+2 schrieb Nia Hughes:
> Hi,
>
>
> Is there a function that can read in methylBaseDB/methylDiffDB flat file databases, similar to how methRead can work on methylRaw(List)DB files? I'd like to source my code into a clean environment on each RStudio startup, but I don't want to have to run calculateDiffMeth every time.
>
>
> Thanks!
> Nia

Hi Nia,

There are internal functions methylKit:::readMethylDiffDB() / methylKit:::readMethylBaseDB() that you can use for this purpose.
Starting from version 1.11.1 there will be the function readMethylDB() to load supported tabix files only from the file path, as we are storing all required information in the header of the tabix file.

If you have any problems with this, please let us know.

Best,
Alex

messages.author: f46993b38e0d7272
messages.subject: Re: Reading in methylBaseDB/methylDiffDB flat files
parts:
This works great - thank you!

As a side note, when working with DBs, the getMethylDiff command appends its filename suffix with a space on both sides (i.e. "methylDiff _suffix .txt.bgz" vs. "methylDiff_suffix.txt.bgz"). This applies to its index file as well, though I'm not sure if this also appears when a suffix is automatically generated (as opposed to having one supplied as a parameter). I poked through the forums briefly but didn't see anyone else mention this.

Nia
